market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure in 1–3 month window. RBA hawkish stance, iron ore weakness, and housing correction cap upside. Gold miners and banks offer relative strength. Expect volatility around RBA decision.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA pivots. Super inflows, gold discovery cycle, and EV transition support structural themes. Key risk is global demand collapse and prolonged high rates suppressing property and growth equities.
